idea: Build a practical end-to-end product for people affected by this real public problem: "Show HN: Make your logo extra bright on HDR screens". Evidence context: Certain logos started standing out to me on LinkedIn as brighter/whiter than everything else around them. I dug in and found out this is accomplished by adding a gain-map to an existing JPEG, visible only on HDR screens like a newer MacBook Pro. LinkedIn is the only social… The product should reduce manual effort, make the main workflow simple for non-experts, provide measurable completion or verification, and prefer reliable integrations over a thin single-feature demo.
